summary: Town pages and the Campspot park record read: 82 serviced stalls, Campspot booking, full-service C$44 a night before GST confirmed; the opening date (May 15 / May long weekend) added and the two pages' different closing dates recorded. Nothing on either campground page describes OHV use at the campground. Note unchanged.
flags: OHV (asked for exact wording): neither campground page mentions OHVs, ATVs, staging or trail access at the campground; both place it only as 'located north of the St. Paul Co-op Mall, beside the soccer fields' / 'north of Cornerstone Co-op, beside the soccer fields'. The only OHV wording is on the town's separate trail page (https://www.stpaul.ca/recreation/iron-horse-trail): 'Accessible year-round, the trail accommodates activities such as UTV, hiking, cycling, horseback riding, wagon rides, and snowmobiling.' The town does not call the campground a trailhead, staging area or part of the trail system; the name is the only link. On Esri imagery it is an in-town serviced RV park (four pull-in rows north of a small trout pond) with no staging lot. Not a drop candidate on what the town says.

FEES (stored C$44/C$44 + C$5 Campspot fee, not rewritten): both town pages list nightly Full Service $44.00, Power Only $34.00, No Power $24.00, and https://www.stpaul.ca/visitors/campgrounds adds 'Prices do not include GST.' The stored low of 44 follows the Campspot types (full-hookup only); if the town's power-only and no-power sites count as RV sites the base would be 24 and fees.tax should say GST is extra. Weekly/monthly differ between the two pages (power only $194/$745 vs $198/$760; no power $133/$510 vs $136/$520). Campspot returned no priced sites for June or July 2027 yet (empty list), so there is no 2027 rate.
SEASON CONFLICT: closing date October 10 (visitors page, Campspot description) vs October 13 (recreation page); 10-10 kept, both in season.note.
MONTHLY: the town sells weekly and monthly rates ($969 a month full service); no page says how many stalls are taken by long stays.
HOOKUP AMPERAGE: stored electric 50 (derived) is not stated by the town; the stored Campspot site types read '30/50amp FHU'. Left as stored.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): the only water is the built trout pond (about 70 x 45 m) 25-40 m south of the south row.

PHONE 780-614-4244 confirmed on both town pages and Campspot. WEBSITES: stpaul.ca pages answer 403 to curl and load in a browser; https://www.campspot.com/park/ironhorse-ab loads in a browser. Google Maps: 'St. Paul Iron Horse Campground', 4.4 stars, 47 reviews.
PIN: 53.99580,-111.26900 is on the south row of the campground (Campspot's point 53.99610,-111.26978); no move. Town address: 4012 53 Avenue.
NAME: the town uses both 'Iron Horse Trail Campground' and 'Iron Horse Campground'.

LEAD (not vetted): the town's second campground, 'Overnight Campground', 4800 55 Street behind the RCMP station: 24 sites with power, 16 without, $34/$24 a night, phone booking 780-614-4244 - check whether it is already in the database.
